extension.description: Fullscreen idle player for the JellyFlam3 flock from Jellyfin (Static MP4 Direct Play). Shuffles archive gens, pedigree, and tuples as one clip each (loop A, morph, loop B — no extra sequencer). After a full mix, re-fetches the catalog (session cap 313). Optional commercial-safe tag filter. Server or flock miss: short hint on black, no bundled test pattern. Separate from the Roku stills screensaver. Last 7 s like/love overlay posts to the furnace vote sink (same map as Roku VoD; tuples skip). Does not render flam3. Client JellyFlam3-Screensaver is ignored by the furnace idle-gate.
